# Open Eyes

> Open Eyes is a free photo app for Android (8.0+) and iPhone (iOS 18+). From 2 to 9 shots of the same moment it takes open eyes or a better smile from one shot and puts them into the shot you like best. Everything runs on the phone: no account, no upload, no ads, no analytics. No pixels are generated by AI; every swapped region is real pixels from another of the user's own shots, and saved photos are labelled as composites.

Open Eyes is not a camera app, not a generative-AI app and does no face recognition (it only locates eyes and mouths). Originals are never modified; each fix is saved as a new photo. Get it on Google Play (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.aralel.openeyes) and the App Store (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/open-eyes-offline-edition/id6823195027). The site is available in English and German (`/de/`).

## Docs
- [How to use](https://your-domain.example/how-to.html): the six steps from choosing shots to saving a copy, tips for shots that fix well, and troubleshooting.
- [Questions and answers](https://your-domain.example/faq.html): privacy, AI, labels, supported phones, limits.
- [How fixed photos are labelled](https://your-domain.example/labels.html): IPTC compositeCapture metadata, C2PA Content Credentials and an invisible watermark.
- [Support](https://your-domain.example/support.html): fixes for common problems and how to get in touch.
